name: skills
description: Team skills library and installable agents: a skill for every task, plus agents that package whole workflows.

plugins.name: conductor
plugins.description: Picks the right skills for your request before doing the work, then executes while showing which skill it applied at each phase. Includes a deeper mode that writes a phased prompt first.

plugins.name: agent-forge
plugins.description: Turns any project into an installable agent: analyzes the project, interviews you, generates skills, wraps them in a plugin, installs to Claude Code and Codex, verifies, and writes the docs.

plugins.name: personal-post
plugins.description: Turns one raw idea into a publish-ready personal LinkedIn post: a specification with copy-ready caption, plus a themed carousel and single-page visual exported to PDF and PNG.
